name: Punishing Your Children
overview: Scripture clearly emphasizes the importance of disciplining children as an expression of love and responsibility. The Old Testament commands severe consequences for disrespecting parents, underscoring the seriousness of honoring family authority (Exodus 21:15,17; Deuteronomy 21:18). Proverbs teaches that withholding discipline is harmful, urging timely correction to guide children in the right path and ensure lasting obedience (Proverbs 13:24; 19:18; 22:6). This discipline is not merely punitive but is intended to train and preserve the child’s well-being and spiritual growth.
